# MultiHUD

MultiHUD is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable HUD mod for Minecraft Fabric.

Designed to provide a client-quality interface without the overhead of a full custom client, MultiHUD allows players to build a personalized HUD experience through a growing collection of configurable modules.

From performance statistics and player information to utility-focused elements and gameplay tracking, MultiHUD offers a wide range of HUD components that can be freely moved, scaled, and customized to fit any playstyle.

## Features

* 10+ customizable HUD modules
* Fully draggable interface
* Independent scaling for every element
* Modern client-inspired design
* Custom keybind support
* Persistent configuration saving
* Lightweight and performance-focused
* Seamless Fabric integration

## Customization

Every module can be positioned anywhere on the screen and adjusted independently, giving you complete control over your layout. Whether you prefer a minimal interface or an information-rich setup, MultiHUD adapts to your needs.

## Performance

Built specifically for Fabric, MultiHUD is designed to remain lightweight while providing a polished and responsive experience with minimal impact on gameplay performance.

## Supported Versions

* **Minecraft 1.26.x** *(actively supported)*
* ~~Minecraft 1.20.x~~ *(no longer actively supported)*
* ~~Minecraft 1.21.x~~ *(no longer actively supported)*
* Fabric Loader

> **Note:** Development now focuses exclusively on the latest Minecraft version. Older versions will not receive further updates or bug fixes.

## Why MultiHUD?

MultiHUD focuses on delivering the customization and usability players expect from modern clients while remaining a standalone Fabric mod. No unnecessary features, no client lock-in, just a flexible HUD system built around choice and performance.
